Everything is an expression: operators are ordinary functions that take any number of arguments, and comparisons chain.

Numeric tower basics and chained comparisons.

```clojure
[(+ 1 2 3)
 (- 10 1 2)
 (* 2 3 4)
 (/ 10 2)
 (< 1 2 3)
 (> 3 2 1)
 (= 2 (+ 1 1))]
```

Output:

```clojure
[6 7 24 5 true true true]
```

Run it yourself — save as `ex.clj` and:

```bash
cljgo run ex.clj      # interpreted, instant
cljgo build           # or ship it as a static binary
```
